dimensions.detail: The requested capabilities, including platform connections, scheduling, publishing, AI drafting, analytics, and brand voices, fit the stated purpose of a social media management platform.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The guide is high level and omits important operational safeguards such as publish confirmation, approval workflows, audit logs, and clear separation of draft/test versus live posting.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains markdown instructions and one markdown reference file only; there are no executable scripts, installer hooks, package manifests, or automatic runtime actions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: OAuth tokens, page tokens, platform credentials, Supabase storage, and RAG inputs are proportionate for this type of tool, but the guide does not spell out encryption, least-privilege scopes, redaction, rotation, or revocation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No system-level persistence, elevated local privileges, hidden background workers, or cross-skill modification are present; the publish queue is application-level behavior expected for scheduled posting.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The credentials table is expected for a social media integration guide, but implementers should not store raw tokens in plain JSONB without encryption, access controls, redaction, and rotation handling.
[SQP-2] expected: Publishing endpoints are central to the skill purpose, but real deployments should require explicit user intent, selected-account review, preview or draft mode, authorization checks, and audit logging before external posts are made.
llm.guidance: Safe to install as a builder guide, not as a finished secure implementation. Before using it for a real product, add a secrets manager or encrypted token storage, least-privilege OAuth scopes, token revocation, publish confirmations, approval flows for scheduled or bulk posting, and logs showing who published to which account.
llm.summary: This is an instruction-only guide for building a social media publishing platform; its sensitive behaviors are disclosed and aligned with that purpose, but it needs careful security implementation.
